FA3 Hopper kernels vendored from
  github.com/vllm-project/flash-attention
  commit f5bc33cfc02c744d24a2e9d50e6db656de40611c
  (matches vllm/cmake/external_projects/vllm_flash_attn.cmake:44 at vllm 0.21.x)

Subset vendored:
  hopper/ — forward-only headers + the four .cu files we compile for paged
            decode (combine, prepare_scheduler, hdim128_bf16_paged_sm90,
            hdim128_bf16_paged_split_sm90)

Backward, fp16, fp8, hdim64/96/192/256, sparse, append-KV, local attention
all excluded by the FLASHATTENTION_DISABLE_* nvcc flags driven from
crates/targets/cuda/builder/build.rs.

The host-side flash_api.cpp is NOT vendored — it pulls in PyTorch
(at::Tensor, torch::*). We reproduce its set_params_fprop logic with raw
GPU pointers in third_party/flash-attn-3-shim/ffi_shim.cu.

Cutlass dependency is shared with the rest of the project (pinned at
62750a2b75c802660e4894434dc55e839f322277 — see
crates/targets/cuda/builder/Cargo.toml).
